content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip are popular platforms for selling digital products, but they have limitations. Gumroad allows creators to sell digital products directly to customers, while Payhip focuses on ebook sales. However, both platforms have significant fees, ranging from 3.5% to 12% of the sale price, and they also charge transaction fees. Additionally, Gumroad has a 3.5% + $0.30 per transaction fee for digital products sold in the United States. On the other hand, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a comprehensive solution for digital creators, with a 0.5% fee on transactions, no hidden fees, and no platform restrictions. It also provides a complete combination of free and paid tools that give any digital creator a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Payhip have restrictions in certain countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines. However, these restrictions do not mean that creators from these countries are unable to sell digital products. Edge Commerce Stack ($197), on the other hand, is designed to provide a solution for digital creators in restricted countries. It uses a combination of free and paid tools that can be deployed in any country, without relying on platforms that are blocked or restricted. This means that digital creators can maintain full control over their online store and payment processing, even in countries where Stripe and other popular platforms are unavailable.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Gumroad and Payhip have limitations when it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery. They often require creators to rely on their platforms for payment processing and delivery, which can lead to delays and lost sales. Edge Commerce Stack ($197), on the other hand, provides full ownership and control over the online store and payment processing. It also automates delivery and payment processing, ensuring that creators receive their earnings quickly and without any hassle. This means that digital creators can focus on creating and marketing their products, rather than worrying about payment processing and delivery.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When choosing a solution for digital commerce, it's essential to consider the fees, payment processing speed, ownership, automation, and delivery. If you're looking for a comprehensive solution that provides full control over your online store and payment processing, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the best choice. It offers a flat 0.5% fee on transactions, faster payment processing, full ownership and control, automation, and delivery. This means that digital creators can keep more of their earnings, focus on creating and marketing their products, and maintain full control over their online store and payment processing.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a one-time payment solution, with no recurring fees or subscriptions.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and start selling digital products, follow these steps: deploy the Stack 02 solution on Cloudflare Pages, configure the payment processing with NOWPayments, set up the order storage with Supabase, configure the SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings, and test the entire system before handoff. Once deployed, you can load up to 5 products, set up automatic crypto payment processing, and configure instant product delivery. This means that digital creators can start selling digital products quickly and easily, without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
